0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>N'nagali is looking at you with motherly concern.

25.original: Deliver the rotting logs to N'nagali.

48.original: <hex:020810E905FF074D6164616D65FF0453697203>, if you could hold out your hand? I have something you really must eat. Please, I insist!

49.original: Is that not the juiciest, sweetest, most invigorating thing you've ever tasted? I just finished baking a batch, and judging by your somewhat wan complexion, I thought you could use a little treat!

50.original: Oh, don't worry─I know exactly what I'm feeding you. Though I've settled here in this haven of archived cultural treasures, I was once a student of the nutritional sciences at the Faculty of Medicine.

51.original: The knowledge from that course certainly comes in useful when it comes to keeping my weary colleagues healthy and hale. ...Although I do struggle to find the time to collect all the ingredients I need.

52.original: In fact, I wonder if you'd be willing to help in that regard? I was about to head out and gather some things east of here, but if you could scour the area to the northwest for a couple of rotting logs, I'd be ever so grateful!

53.original: Yes, rotting logs! They don't need to be massive, but I will need them intact!

55.original: Yes! These should be <hex:021A020203>riddled<hex:021A020103> with the little darlings!

56.original: Thank you, both from me, and on behalf of my sure-to-be-appreciative fellow archivists! After all, no dish has more nutritional value than one made with beetle larvae!
